title: Even Buffett had losing years
summary_lines: Buffett lost to the S&P 500 in 21 of 61 years.

facts.post:
Buffett lost to the S&P 500 in 21 of 61 years.
In 1999 the market gained 21.0% and Berkshire fell 19.9%.

$1,000 in Berkshire at the end of 1964 was about $61.0 million by the end of 2025.

Ever held something that lagged for years?
facts.reply: Every year side by side, plus ten-year stretches, straight from Berkshire's own scorecard.
facts.s3_label: Berkshire in 1999, while the S&P 500 did +21.0%

facts.s4_note: Same $1,000 in the S&P 500: $461,610 (letter's figures, before taxes)
